scenarios.title: Verify initial state of diff editor watermark with empty diff
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that when no diff is loaded, the editor watermark with text 'Waiting for a diff' is visible exactly as before the patch.

scenarios.title: Verify Clear diff button is disabled when diff is empty
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that the Clear diff button is disabled if the diff textarea is empty, confirming unchanged behavior.

scenarios.title: Verify Run button disabled state with empty diff and empty URL and not ready API
scenarios.purpose: Verify that the Analyze change (Run) button is disabled when both diff and pull request URL inputs are empty and apiReady is false, matching the previous behavior exactly.

scenarios.title: Verify setup inline message when API not ready
scenarios.purpose: Confirm that when apiReady is false, the inline setup message containing exact text about configuring OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL is visible as before the patch.

steps.value: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.
steps.expected: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.
